What is a Frame?

Frames are community knowledge spaces — not threads, not wikis, not tutorials. Something different.

💬

Discussion Sections

Threaded conversations organized by topic. Pin important threads, lock resolved ones.

📎

Resource Collections

Curated links, tools, repos, and references. The library your discipline deserves.

❓

Living FAQ

Community-maintained answers that evolve as knowledge deepens — never static.

👥

Open Membership

Anyone can join by contributing. No gatekeeping — participate and you're in.

Explore by Discipline

Every category is a world. Pick one, or create a subcategory that doesn't exist yet.
